cohort: Nulliparous women with spontaneous onset of labor at ≥37 weeks with single cephalic fetuses in Slovenia in 2013 and 2014
finding: Significant differences in the rates of caesarean section and cephalopelvic disproportion were observed among different maternity units in Slovenia, suggesting variations in clinical practice.
mod_finding: The most common indication for CS was cephalopelvic disproportion, which was diagnosed with different frequency in different units.
